text:
4 former Beekmantown High School athletes set for college competition the week ending Sept. 6
Four former Beekmantown High School athletes appear on college rosters for the week ending Sept. 6. Sophomore Peyton Hooker is listed with Husson women's volleyball, which is scheduled to host the University of Maine at Fort Kent on Sept. 1.
Women's soccer and women's volleyball are represented by Binghamton, Husson, Plattsburgh State and SUNY Potsdam. The listed teams have 12 scheduled events during the week ending Sept. 6.
Each athlete's college team and scheduled events are listed below.
Former Beekmantown High School Athletes Scheduled for College Action — Week Ending September 6
Grace McCasland
Binghamton women's soccer — America East
Schedule: Hosts Syracuse University on September 3 in Vestal, NY; Visits University of Maryland on September 6 in College Park, MD
Peyton Hooker
Husson women's volleyball — NAC
Schedule: Hosts University of Maine at Fort Kent on September 1 in Bangor, ME; Visits Trinity College (Conn.) on September 5 in Hartford, CT
Mia Perez
SUNY Potsdam women's volleyball — SUNYAC
Schedule: Hosts St. Lawrence on September 1 in Potsdam, NY; Hosts VTSU-Johnson on September 2 in Potsdam, NY; Hosts Hartwick on September 4 in Plattsburgh, NY; Visits Plattsburgh on September 5 in Plattsburgh, NY; Hosts Sage on September 5 in Plattsburgh, NY
Sophie Miller
Plattsburgh State women's soccer — SUNYAC
Schedule: Hosts Vermont State University Castleton on September 1 in Plattsburgh, NY; Visits Farmingdale State College on September 5 in Farmingdale, NY; Hosts Stevens on September 6 in Farmingdale, NY
